claim: Next-gen file sharing platform for organizations; full rewrite in Go with micro-service architecture
Prerequisites: Go 1.21 or higher to build, MySQL 5.6 or higher or MariaDB equivalent
Run ./cells configure then ./cells start; default site at https://localhost:8080/
Binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows distributions
Tested on macOS, Ubuntu, Debian and CentOS; Windows might have unknown glitches and is not yet supported
README does not mention desktop or mobile sync clients
